title: Budget verdicts
responsibility: Compares one unit’s measurements with reviewed frozen limits and compatible performance baselines, preserving missing and unavailable evidence as explicit findings.

inputs.name: budgetFindings.input
inputs.description: The unit to judge, with its machine profile, default execution target, performance budgets, measurements and reviewed baseline (undefined when none was reviewed). Only this unit's measurements are judged: emitted sizes always are, source-bytes, complexity and dependencies only when checkSize is true, and performance is compared only within the profile.

measurements.method: Median of 5 batches of 1000 awaited representative calls after 3 warmups; includes await overhead.

performance.method: Median of 5 batches of 1000 awaited representative calls after 3 warmups; includes await overhead.

inputs.name: isFrozen.metric
inputs.description: The metric name to test. It is frozen when it is source-bytes, complexity or dependencies, or when it begins with artifact-bytes, and every other name, including each performance metric, is not frozen.

inputs.name: performanceLimit.metric
inputs.description: The metric whose direction decides the limit. Only throughput-ops is better when larger, and every other metric, such as latency-warm-ms or memory-bytes, is better when smaller.

inputs.name: performanceLimit.baseline
inputs.description: The reviewed value that the tolerance is applied to, in the unit of measure of its metric: ms for the latency metrics, ops/s for throughput-ops and bytes for memory-bytes. Nothing checks its range, so a baseline of 0 gives a limit of 0.

inputs.name: performanceLimit.tolerance
inputs.description: The allowed fractional regression: 0.05 allows five percent, and 0 makes the baseline itself the limit. Performance budgets accept tolerances only from 0 to 0.05 (performanceTolerance), but this function applies any number it is given.

outputs.name: frozenMetrics
outputs.description: The readonly list of frozen source metric names, in this order: source-bytes, complexity and dependencies. Each is checked only when checkSize is true, and a measured value above its reviewed baseline is exceeded.

outputs.name: isFrozen
outputs.description: True when the metric is source-bytes, complexity or dependencies, or begins with artifact-bytes, and false for every other metric.

outputs.name: budgetFindings
outputs.description: One finding for each frozen source metric when checkSize is true, one for each emitted size of this unit and one for each performance budget, in that order. Each status is passed, exceeded, missing-baseline, missing-measurement, unavailable, incomplete or incompatible, and only emitted-size findings name a target.

outputs.name: performanceLimit
outputs.description: The baseline moved by the tolerance in the worse direction, decreased for throughput-ops and increased for every other metric, and rounded to twelve significant digits. A measured value exactly at this limit is still acceptable.
